Job Description:

The vision of the GRC Technology Center of Excellence is to empower all Associates and Contractors at Mars to manage risk. This vision drives the team’s mission to be a customer-focused, results-oriented team that cares about the vision of implementing and enabling governance, risk and compliance (GRC) processes through GRC tooling.
The GRC Technology Center of Excellence delivers exceptional customer experiences through process consulting, technology deployment and platform support. The team currently leverages Archer as its GRC technology of choice, however as the team continues to grow there may be opportunities to expand technical skills and capabilities, such as other GRC tools, data visualization, integration, AI agent creation, Model Context Protocols and more.
The GRC Product Consultant works with internal customers to understand and consult on their processes, provide visibility into the Mars governance, risk, and compliance landscape, act as a business analyst and product manager, and configure tools to meet customer needs. The GRC Product Consultant will be a key member of the GRC Technology Center of Excellence within Information Security’s Risk and Governance function, and will provide consulting and tooling services across the organization.  Additionally, the GRC Product Lead will assist in expanding the team’s footprint to additional risk functions and teams, new technologies, executing against the strategic roadmap, and providing key feedback for governance and strategic direction of the program.

- Bachelor’s Degree in IT/computer science/Business Administration/MIS or a similar field
- Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience

- A self-starter attitude, being able to manage a changing workload

- Experience in a consulting role delivering/leading projects for customers

- Understand and advise on customer processes and requirements

- Strong process orientation, including understanding processes and data flows, and ability to identify process improvement areas
- Convert customer requirements into technical requirements and enable them using Archer

Job Description:

Assignment September 2026 to October 2027

Royal Canin is undertaking a major transformation programme called EOS to deliver against its strategy of being Fit for Future and removing business risk.  The transformation has 4 key elements: new technology, E2E standardized core processes, a strengthened data & analytics foundation, supported by a dedicated transformation team and change management.  Following a successful pilot the 1st wave of implementations will go live in summer 2027 and RC EKA (European Key Accounts) will participate in the first wave.  The approach will see local associates with relevant expertise moving onto the project and their day-to-day roles covered via backfills for the length of the project.
This role will be part of the backfill team covering day to day responsibilities in the running of the unit and it offers pan European perspective and stakeholders, in-depth and varied customer dynamics, and an agile entrepreneurial environment.  The primary responsibilities of the role are to lead sound financial operational processes for the unit and strengthening the foundations. This includes delivering financial reporting accuracy & compliance, the creation of a secure internal control environment and excellent governance around customer contracts and investments, plus supporting the CFO and EKA Business Partners on optimization of unit financial KPIs especially Overheads and Cash.

What are we looking for?
- Master’s Degree BA / Business School or professional accounting qualification
- Significant experience in custodianship and financial operations within complex environments

What will be your Key Responsbilities?

Create and manage financial reporting ensuring an efficient and effective period close process that delivers -accurate information; -maintenance of appropriate supporting documentation; - identification and timely resolution of complex accounting matters; - review including monitoring of key performance indicators to identify insights;  - compliance with all Mars Finance Manual policies, Recurring Reports Manual and other guidance/practices including compliance to local GAAP/statutory and other local legal/regulatory requirements -Plan and manage the year-end and/or other audit processes with the internal and external auditors, where applicable, including timely resolution of all findings and comments. Serve as a liaison with specialist teams (e.g., Treasury, Tax, 1Navision ERP and Currency Centers) and ensure appropriate unit compliance with all related requirements.

Create and maintain a secure internal control environment including appropriate segregation of duties by providing leadership and expertise. Be a role model for ethics, integrity and trust in all areas including ensuring identification of and appropriate responses to fraud and theft. – Accountable for the ICE programme delivery to optimize effective controls with the objective of minimizing risk. Ensure Blackline timeliness and quality back up for accruals.

Manage and streamline all finance-impacted processes in compliance with Mars requirements and to increase overall efficiency . Be the first point of contact for Auditors and taxes. Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access, and controls can be managed within the system(s). Be responsible for Cost Collector maintenance in 1NAV.

Lead financial systems development projects in line with RC and Mars programmes (excluding EOS).  Identify opportunities for local continuous improvement in data quality, processes, documentation and systems in readiness for EOS transformation.

Be a key contributor to understanding unit financial performance of actuals in an accurate and timely manner, with specific responsibilities for analysing Overheads and Free Cashflow. Drive actionable performance insights, robust forecasts and identify, assess and communicate risks and opportunities on Overheads and NCFO into the unit. On Overheads act as Business Partner to the Leadership Team, especially GM and P&O Director, to deliver targets and optimize the budget.

Together with external consultants, manage the tax obligations across Europe (currently 4 VAT jurisdictions).

Provide day to day supervision of tasks across the Financial Operations day-to-day team and work with the EOS Finance Lead to effectively manage resources and bring out the best in the team.  Provide strong work planning and monitoring to enable the team to stay on track with all day to day and EOS work. Bring strong contribution to the overall EKA Finance team, including acting as a sounding board to business partner roles and input into the CFO + Direct Reports HPC and engagement activities.

Be a strong contributor to the RC Europe Financial Controller community , sharing learnings and best practices plus collaborating across the region to deliver its controllership priorities efficiently and effectively.

Job Description:

The Commercial Finance Director is the lead Finance representative on the Commercial Leadership Team and owns the Finance agenda for the Commercial organization. As the strategic finance partner to the VP of Commercial, this role provides independent financial leadership, constructive challenge, and an outside-in perspective to shape sourcing strategy and decisions.

Szukamy osoby, która obejmie rolę Kierownika/ Kierowniczki Produkcji Lean Managera  i będzie miała realny wpływ na sposób funkcjonowania organizacji.  To stanowisko dla osoby, która nie tylko zarządza produkcją, ale przede wszystkim rozwija kulturę ciągłego doskonalenia, buduje zaangażowanie zespołów i skutecznie wdraża rozwiązania Lean.

- Współpraca z innymi działami w celu osiągania celów biznesowych i operacyjnych.

- Minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w środowisku produkcyjnym na stanowisku związanym z Lean Management.
- Praktyczne doświadczenie we wdrażaniu i wykorzystywaniu narzędzi oraz metod Lean, takich jak Kaizen, 5S, VSM, Standard Work, Daily Management czy Problem Solving.

- Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu i koordynowaniu projektów optymalizacyjnych.

W związku z dynamicznym rozwojem naszej organizacji poszukujemy osoby, która chce mieć realny wpływ na jej przyszłość i wspólnie z nami tworzyć kulturę Lean. Job Description:

Team & Arbeitsumfeld
Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, datengetriebenen Category Management Teams, das als Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb (Key Account Management), Marketing und den führenden Handelspartnern in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz fungiert. In unserem Food & Nutrition Team arbeitest Du auf Augenhöhe, übernimmst früh Eigenverantwortung und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die FMCG-Entscheidungsprozesse bei Mars.
Deine Rolle & Mehrwert:  Du analysierst und interpretierst umfangreiche Marktforschungs- und Abverkaufsdaten in greifbare Handlungsempfehlungen. Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für Sortiments- und Platzierungsempfehlungen im Handel.
Mögliche Projektfelder:
- Shopper Insights & Trend-Scouting: Identifikation von Marktpotenzialen und Konsumententrends
- Sortiments- & Regaloptimierung: Konzeption und datengestützte Ableitung von optimierten Planogrammen und kundenindividuellen Handlungsempfehlungen für den Lebensmitteleinzelhandel (LEH)
- Weiterentwicklung eines kanalspezifischen Perfect Store Konzeptes für den deutschen Markt

Deine Aufgaben
- Category- & Marktdaten-Analysen: Eigenständige Erhebung, Aufbereitung und Interpretation von Abverkaufs- und Paneldaten (z.,B. Nielsen Discover, SimIT) zur Identifikation von Markt- und Wachstumstreibern zur Unterstützung unseres Category Management Teams.
- Category Reporting: Verantwortung für kontinuierliche Updates interner Category-Reports, Performance-Scorecards und relevanter abteilungsübergreifender Dashboards.
- Perfect-Store-Performance: Detaillierte Analyse und Nachhaltung der Point-of-Sale-KPIs (Perfect Store) inklusive datenbasierter Ableitung und Begleitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen.
- Vertriebsunterstützung & Ad-hoc-Analysen (DE & CH): Erstellung überzeugender, datengestützter Category-Storylines für Kundengespräche sowie rasche Beantwortung komplexer Ad-hoc-Fragestellungen für die Märkte Deutschland und Schweiz.

Dein Profil
Must-Haves (Voraussetzungen):
- Laufendes Studium: Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften (BWL/VWL), Wirtschaftsinformatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
- Starke analytische Denkweise: Ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Rohdaten verständliche Schlüsse zu ziehen.
- Exzellente MS-Office-Kenntnisse: Sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Excel (Pivot, SVERWEIS/XVERWEIS, Datenbereinigung) sowie routinierte Erstellung aussagekräftiger PowerPoint-Folien.
- Sprachkompetenz: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) und verhandlungssicheres bzw. gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Nice-to-Haves (Wünschenswert):
- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im deutschen FMCG-Umfeld, im Handel oder in analytischen Bereichen (z. B. Trade Marketing, Brand Management, Revenue Management, Vertrieb).
- Erste Berührungspunkte mit Marktforschungsdatenbanken (Nielsen Discover, SimIT Web) oder Space-Management-Software (z. B. PlanogramXP).
- Grundkenntnisse in BI-/Visualisierungstools (z. B. Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, ThinkCell).

Unser Angebot
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten: Faire Vereinbarkeit von Studium und Beruf durch flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (bis zu 20 Std./Woche) sowie die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten / Homeoffice.
- Steile Lernkurve & Mentoring: Intensive Einarbeitung, direkte Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen und regelmäßiges Feedback für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung.
- Echte Verantwortung & Netzwerk: Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und Projekte inklusive wertvoller abteilungsübergreifender Kontakte im FMCG-Sektor und Chancen für einen späteren Festeinstieg.

Dauer: min. 6 Monate
Ort: Verden (hybrid)
